report:
I'd merge this as is. I found nothing the contributor has to fix.

**Checks run** (the working tree is unchanged, and `git status` matches what I started with):
- `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes.
- `cargo test` passes: 156 unit tests and 122 integration tests, including the four new `test_count*` tests.

**How it works.** The receiver in `src/walk.rs` adds up matches instead of buffering and printing them. When the search ends, either because it is finished or because it hit `--max-results`, `stop()` prints a single `N\n`. A broken pipe is ignored. `Config::is_printing()` now returns false in count mode, so fd skips colouring entries and doesn't install its Ctrl-C handler, which is only needed when printing.

**Edge cases I ran against `target/debug/fd`:**

| Command | Output | Matches the issue |
|---|---|---|
| `fd --count rs` | `3`, exit 0 | yes |
| `fd --count nomatch` | `0`, exit 0 | yes |
| `fd --count rs a c` (several paths) | one total, `3` | yes |
| `fd --count -1 rs` | `1` | yes |
| `fd --count -e rs --max-results 2` | `2` | yes |
| `fd --count rs \| head -c0` | exit 0, no error message | yes |
| `--count` with `--exec`, `-l`, `-0`, `--has-results` (an alias of `--quiet`) | clap usage error, exit 2 | yes |
| `--count` with an invalid search path | same error as without `--count` | yes |

The tests also cover the conflict rule from both sides (`--count` given first and given last), `--format`, `--exec-batch`, and the filter options.

**Docs and changelog.** The man page entry sits after `--quiet` and lists the conflicting options correctly. The CHANGELOG line is under "Upcoming Release / Features". Nothing outside the issue was changed and no stray files were left behind.

**Nits:**
- The help text says the option "cannot be combined with output or exec options". That is vague: `--color`, `--hyperlink` and `--absolute-path` are output options and they are allowed. Naming the six conflicting options, as the man page does, would be clearer.
- `contrib/completion/_fd` doesn't list `--count`. That file isn't kept up to date for other options either (`--quiet` and `--format` are missing), so I'm not counting it as a convention break.
